correctness.rationale: The first update gives irreversible consensus in a two-vertex copy graph. Thus difference equals (a-b) on the no-event event and zero elsewhere, so mean gap is product first-event survivals. Uniform [0,2] has S(2)=0; its renewal density for u<2 is exp(u/2)/2. Substitution into source Eq (2.9) gives strict negative residual -(a-b)(11-4e); its integral representation is positive. Algebra and exact coefficients were checked in verify.py. No unproved continuity or infinite enumeration assumption.
